name.help: The name of the company. A new row is not created without it.

cui.help: With or without the country prefix. It finds companies that already exist so they are filled in, not duplicated.

phone.help: Separate several numbers with / , or ;. Format the column as text so a leading zero is kept.

contact.help: The name of the person at the company, as text.

website.help: The site address, with or without https://.

revenue.help: A number with no currency. 1,500,000.50 style also works.

year.help: The year the revenue refers to, 4 digits.

status.help: A status from the catalog. If we cannot find it, a new row gets the default status.

notes.example: They asked for a quote in March
notes.help: Free text. It becomes a note on the company.

owner.help: The email of an active colleague. It is used only if you have the assign permission.
